title: acme-orders nightly import, 2-3 October 2026
subtitle: Two mornings without the order import after a deploy; what happened, why as far as the evidence goes, and what changes.

verdict.text: Commit 49bc16d removed decimal-comma handling from `parse_amount` and the test that covered it; the first export with `12,50` after the 1 October deploy stopped the whole import for two mornings (bug-hunt, reproduced). The change that matters most: the regression test is back and CI runs it, so the same removal cannot ship again unnoticed. [high]

blocks.code:
# Postmortem: nightly order import failed, 2-3 October 2026

Date: 2026-10-02 06:00 to 2026-10-03 16:00 (CEST)    Severity: SEV2    Status: draft
Roles: lead, comms, fix

## Summary
The nightly import of orders-2026-10-02.csv failed on 2 and 3 October with decimal.InvalidOperation in
parse_amount. Finance noticed the missing day at 09:30 on 2 October. The code was rolled back on 3 October
at 10:00 and both files re-imported; the fix was deployed at 16:00. No order was lost.

## Impact
- Finance and the admin panel had no orders of 2 October for 28 hours; 3 October's file was imported 4 hours late.

## Timeline (CEST)
| Time | Event | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 30 Sep 17:42 | commit 49bc16d removes decimal-comma handling and its test | git |
| 1 Oct 18:05 | deploy c376ea1 | log:7 |
| 2 Oct 06:00 | first failed run, nothing saved | log:8-26 |
| 2 Oct 09:30 | finance reports the missing day | lead |
| 3 Oct 06:00 | second failed run, same file | log:27-45 |
| 3 Oct 09:00 | triage: SEV2 | incident-triage page |
| 3 Oct 09:40 | root cause reproduced | bug-hunt page |
| 3 Oct 10:00 | rollback to d22ee8f, re-import of both days | lead |
| 3 Oct 16:00 | fix deployed | lead |

## Root cause
parse_amount no longer accepted a decimal comma after 49bc16d; the first such row ended the run before any write.

## Contributing factors
- The covering test was deleted in the same commit, so CI stayed green.
- No alert on a failed cron run; no check after the deploy.
- The export's decimal format was not documented.
- Cron re-runs the same file after a failure.

## What went well
- The run fails before its first write: no partial day, a safe re-run.
- The rollback worked first time.

## What went poorly
- 210 minutes to detect, by a person; a full day to mitigate.

## Action items
| Action | Factor | Role | Check | Done when |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| restore test_decimal_comma; same parser and a test for read_adjustments | test deleted | fix | tests fail on 49bc16d | merged |
| alert on a non-zero cron exit | no alert | lead | fires on a replay of log:10 | alert exists |
| document the export format in README | undocumented format | fix | README names it | merged |
| change-review before deploying changes to importer.py | unreviewed removal | lead | the next change has a review page | first review |

## Open questions
- Why the test was deleted: the commit message does not say, and there is no review record.
